in_hebrew.name: Anatolio
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Greek: Sun God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Anatolio הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'Anatolios', meaning 'sun-godly' or 'sun-risen'. In Christianity, the name Anatolio is associated with devotion and faith, as the sun symbolizes the light of God.

in_latin.name: Anatolio
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Greek: Sun God
in_latin.long_meaning: Anatolio est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'Anatolios', meaning 'sun-godly' or 'sun-risen'. In Christianity, the name Anatolio is associated with devotion and faith, as the sun symbolizes the light of God.
